```{r}

library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# setup images directories
img_dir <- "manyfaces"
proc_dir <- file.path(img_dir, "small") # use small for testing

```

```{r}
imgs <- read_stim(proc_dir, "_std_neu_0")

# fix CR2
cr2 <- which(width(imgs) < max(width(imgs)))

imgs[cr2] <- resize(imgs[cr2], 
                    width = max(width(imgs)), 
                    height = max(height(imgs)))
```


```{r}
lab <- substr(names(imgs), 1, 6)
labs <- unique(lab)
names(labs) <- labs

wm_opts(fill = "white")
img_by_lab <- lapply(labs, \(i) imgs[lab == i])
img_by_lab$keep_relative = TRUE
img_by_lab$maxwidth = 5000
img_by_lab$size = 60
do.call(plot_rows, img_by_lab) |>
  write_stim(dir = "manyfaces/figs", 
             names = "orig", 
             format = "jpg", 
             overwrite = TRUE)
  
```

```{r}
wm_opts(fill = "red") # to highlight cropping for testing
```



## Align on Eyes

```{r}
# alignment defaults
align_args <- list(
  stimuli = imgs,
  width = 600,
  height = 800,
  x1 = 220,
  x2 = 380,
  y1 = 350,
  y2 = 350
)

eyes <- do.call(align, args = align_args)
```


```{r}
# quick checking viz - pupils aligned and horizontal
average_tem(eyes) |> draw_tem()
```

```{r}
plot_stim(eyes, ncol = 21, fill = "black") |>
  write_stim(dir = "manyfaces/figs", 
             names = "align_eyes", 
             format = "jpg", 
             overwrite = TRUE)
```

![](manyfaces/figs/align_eyes.png)

## Whitepoint adjustment

```{r}
patch <- crop(imgs, 100, 100, 100, 350)
labels <- gsub("_std_neu_0", "", names(patch)) |> gsub("MF00\\d\\d_", "", x = _)

labeled_patch <- patch |>
  label(label = labels, size = 25, y = .9)

wm_opts(fill = "white")
img_by_lab <- lapply(labs, \(i) labeled_patch[lab == i])
img_by_lab$keep_relative = TRUE
img_by_lab$maxwidth = 5000
img_by_lab$size = 60
do.call(plot_rows, img_by_lab) |>
  write_stim(dir = "manyfaces/figs", 
             names = "patch", 
             format = "jpg", 
             overwrite = TRUE)
```

https://www.easyrgb.com/en/math.php
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/54470148/white-balance-a-photo-from-a-known-point


```{r}
patch <- patch(imgs, 100, 100, 100, 350)
lab <- sapply(patch, color_conv, to = "lab") |>
  t() |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "id")
```



## 1-point alignment


```{r}
fill_patch <- patch(imgs, x_off = 20, y_off = 20 )

h <- 900
w <- h/4*3
align_args <- list(
  stimuli = imgs,
  width = w,
  height = h,
  pt1 = 71,
  pt2 = 71,
  x1 = w/2,
  x2 = w/2,
  y1 = h*.4,
  y2 = h*.4,
  fill = fill_patch
)

onepoint <- do.call(align, args = align_args)
```


```{r}
write_stim(onepoint, "manyfaces/onepoint/", format = "jpg")
```


```{r}
# quick checking viz
average_tem(onepoint) |> draw_tem()
```

```{r}
plot_stim(onepoint, ncol = 21, fill = "black") |>
  write_stim(dir = "manyfaces/figs", 
             names = "align_onepoint2", 
             format = "jpg", 
             overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Resize for distance

```{r}
std_neu <- list.files("manyfaces/small", "\\.jpg", full.names = T)

exif <- readxl::read_excel("Exif_processed.xlsx", sheet = 2) |>
  mutate(smallpath = SourceFile |>
    gsub("manyfaces.*/MF", "manyfaces/small/MF", x = _) |>
    gsub("CR(3|2)", "jpg", x = _) |>
    gsub("(-|_+)", "_", x = _)
  ) |>
  filter(grepl("_std_neu_0\\.", smallpath),
         !grepl("test", smallpath)) |>
  select(smallpath, Group, resize = 23) |>
  filter(smallpath %in% std_neu) |>
  mutate(resize = ifelse(Group == "MF0016", 1, resize) ) |>
  arrange(smallpath) |>
  tidyr::fill(resize) # missing MF0018 filled from other MF0018


same <- exif$smallpath |> gsub("manyfaces/small/", "", x = _) |>
  gsub("\\.jpg", "", x = _) == names(imgs)

stopifnot(all(same))

resized <- resize(imgs, exif$resize)
```

```{r}
fill_patch <- patch(resized)
#fill_patch <- "red"
h <- 840
w <- h/4*3
eye_height <- .45
align_args <- list(
  stimuli = resized,
  width = w,
  height = h,
  pt1 = 71,
  pt2 = 71,
  x1 = w/2,
  x2 = w/2,
  y1 = h*eye_height,
  y2 = h*eye_height,
  fill = fill_patch
)

onepoint_resize <- do.call(align, args = align_args)
```


```{r}
write_stim(onepoint_resize, 
           "manyfaces/resized1point/", 
           format = "jpg", 
           overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
plot_stim(onepoint_resize, ncol = 21, fill = "black") |>
  write_stim(dir = "manyfaces/figs", 
             names = "align_onepoint_resized2", 
             format = "jpg", 
             overwrite = TRUE)
```
